name: telegram-mcp-work
description: Local Telegram search, history and media for ChatGPT Work on Windows. Each user signs in to their own account.

interface.shortDescription: Search your Telegram chats from ChatGPT Work.
interface.longDescription: Local Windows Telegram integration. Search, read messages and download media. Sending is disabled until explicitly enabled locally. Requires the Windows installer and your own Telegram login.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find messages in my Telegram chats.
